notes.title: Holy Shot Demo 2.0.1 Update
Holy Shot Demo 2.0.0 Update
Holy Shot Demo Play
notes.content:
Blessed are those who pull the trigger and don’t let go until the magazine’s empty! Get ready for a frenetic top-down action experience. Battle relentless hordes of demons and tough-as-nails bosses in a world of chaotic destruction, armed with the most powerful and blessed weapons.



Highlights
Physics-Based Gameplay: Destroy the environment around you, blow up entire mountains, and unleash firestorms upon floods of arachnids!

Strategy & Progression: Know your enemies and arsenal, create effective strategies, and push further each time.

Boss Battles: Study and defeat unique, challenging bosses.

Diverse Arsenal: Set up turrets and explosives, use several weapon types, find the best power-up combinations,
and escape massive hordes with nuclear blasts and holy rains.

Unique Visual Style: Uncover secrets and explore a world filled with angelic and demonic imagery, featuring grotesque and bizarre monsters.
